result.decisiveNextEvidence: One minimal run: replay the no-Tool structured-result Run's ToolBridge boundary under read-only instrumentation to pinpoint the single Harness-owned control/state interaction that misclassified the correction event — reproducing or refuting the causal claim with the smallest reproducible falsifier.
result.reason: H-NOTOOL leads on all four discriminating priors. It has a real, bounded reproduction request already on the owner's plate (a reproduced burden, not conceptual completeness), and the smallest falsifier is explicitly the target: one exact Harness-owned control/state interaction misclassified at the ToolBridge boundary. Evidence cost is closed-loop low (read-only discovery into an existing failing run), whereas G-HUMAN has 0/11 responses — no observation is currently available at any price, so it fails the "observation that can justify a causal target" stop criterion. F-LIVE is high-value but consequence-bearing and deliberately excluded by "do not take owner authority" + real-capital reconciliation cost; it stays alive but deferred. R-WITNESS is a close second: physical adversarial test with a crisp falsifier, but it costs more materials/authority to set up and risks semantic-distortion detour that H-NOTOOL already has scoped. H-DISCOVERY is efficiency measurement (useful but frontier-changing only after H-NOTOOL's causal bug is resolved, since a no-change on 203 observations presumes the control path is healthy). HOST-PKG and S-UNKNOWN are narrower representation gaps with lower causal reach.
